tone: friendly-professional, second-person, conversational. No exclamation marks. No emoji. Avoid marketing-speak inflation.
formality: 존댓말 (haeyo-che, 해요체). Polite but warm — neither casual 반말 nor stiff 합니다체. End sentences with -요/-에요/-ㅂ니다 mixed naturally. Use second-person 손님 / 여러분 / 당신 sparingly; prefer subject-omission where Korean would naturally drop it.

terminology.note: green fee — write closed, no space.
caddie fee — write closed. Caddie = 캐디; caddie tip = 캐디 팁.
the act of playing a round. Use 라운드 ONLY as a counter/quantity (예: 1라운드, 라운드당).
screen golf — write closed. Used as the familiar KO frame of reference for the simulator.

currency.format: Half-width Arabic digits + 바트 (Hangul), no space: 1,800바트, 550~950바트. Comma thousands separator.
currency.note: RULING: guide/explainer content spells the currency as 바트 (dominant across shipped KO guide entries — lessons, green-fee, round-cost, baggage, screen-golf). The Latin 'THB' abbreviation appears only in table column labels / preserved fragments; do NOT use it in KO prose. messages/ko.json UI copy mixes THB and 바트 per its own namespace history; leave it as-is.

conventions.ranges: ASCII tilde ~ (U+007E) between values, no spaces: 25~30kg, 550~950바트, 4~7kg.
conventions.numerals: Arabic digits only; never Korean/Sino-Korean numeral words for figures.

honesty_constraints.required_scoping: Negative claims about coach languages must be scoped to LENGOLF (e.g. 'LENGOLF에 한국인 코치나 한국어 레슨은 없지만…'), never stated city-wide about Bangkok. City-wide statements may only be POSITIVE and general (e.g. '방콕에서는 영어로 진행하는 레슨이 일반적이에요').
honesty_constraints.allowed_language_support: 예약·사전 상담은 booking.len.golf 또는 LINE @lengolf에서 한국어로 도와드립니다 (booking/consultation in Korean via LINE @lengolf; online booking via booking.len.golf). Also: on-screen simulator numbers (헤드 스피드, 발사각) help across the language barrier. Do NOT claim Korean-language lessons or Korean coaches.
honesty_constraints.linter_hint: Flag each forbidden_claims string for human REVIEW (not auto-reject) when it appears WITHOUT LENGOLF-scoped negation nearby (없지만／없습니다／없어요 within the same sentence or paragraph) AND the LINE @lengolf allowance. These are honesty rules, not lexical bans.

transliterations.note: KO transliterates the BTS station name (BTS 칫롬역) but keeps 'The Mercury Ville' in Latin ('The Mercury Ville 4층'). Keep LENGOLF, len.golf, BTS, MRT, PGA, LINE @lengolf, booking.len.golf, and Latin brand/product names (Callaway, REVA) verbatim.

seo_norms.title_display_target: ~30 characters, front-loaded with the target query, then the descriptive tail. When the head is itself a question, end it with ? and start the tail after one space (골프 클럽 대여, 그걸로 충분할까? 품질 판단 기준); add the ? if a question-shaped head (-까, -나요) lacks one. Otherwise use a colon attached to the head and followed by one space (태국 골프 초보자 가이드: 시작 전 알아야 할 모든 것), a comma when the head is a topic leading into a question (방콕 골프, 하루 중 언제가 좋을까?), or join a noun head and a label tail with a space (블랙마운틴 골프클럽 후아힌 방문 가이드). Never an em dash (— or ——) or a look-alike used as the separator (–, ―, ─, －, the Hangul vowel ㅡ, a spaced hyphen, a double hyphen --), never a mid-title period, and never | (the layout already appends " | LENGOLF"). Most shipped KO guide and FAQ titles still use an em-dash tail: legacy debt, do not copy it. Shipped guide titles 20–37 chars (2026-09).
seo_norms.meta_note: Hook + target query in the first ~80 characters; KO meta truncates around 80 chars on mobile SERP. Shipped guide metas run ~90–160 chars.
seo_norms.front_load: Lead with the reader's query (예: 골프백 수하물 요금), not the brand.

style_notes: 해요체 (haeyo-che) as the default warm-polite register; drop into 합니다체 sparingly for emphasis or list/summary sentences.
For list intros prefer '다음과 같아요' / '다음과 같습니다' over colloquial '이래요'.
Spacing: 드라이빙 레인지 (with space); but 그린피 / 캐디피 / 티타임 / 스크린골프 / 올인클루시브 written closed.
Arabic digits + 바트/달러/kg with no space (1,800바트, 6kg).
No exclamation marks, no emoji. Subject-omission where Korean naturally drops it.

No em dash (— or ——) anywhere in copy, per the owner's house style, and no look-alike used as a separator in its place (–, ―, ─, －, the Hangul vowel ㅡ, a spaced hyphen, a double hyphen --). Titles are covered by seo_norms.title_display_target, and the next note covers body copy. One exception: the ' — ' venue delimiter inside price_breakdown[].item in data/price-guide-pages.ts is a code separator (PriceGuidePage.groupPriceRows() splits on it), so keep it byte-for-byte as ' — ' (half-width space, one — (U+2014), half-width space; never ——, a look-alike such as ― (U+2015, which the Korean IME symbol menu offers) or ㅡ, a colon, a hyphen or a dash without its spaces) exactly where the EN entry has one, copying it from the EN entry rather than typing it, and add none elsewhere. Shipped KO copy still contains em dashes: that is legacy debt for a separate native-QA sweep, not a pattern to copy.

In body copy, replace an em dash by what it was doing. Between two clauses, end the sentence and start a new one, first changing the ending to a 해요체 final one where needed (너무 멀어요. 이동 시간을…), since a period straight after -어 or -고 reads as 반말 or a broken fragment; use a comma only when the second part continues the same sentence, as it does after a connective ending such as -고, -지만, -는데 or -면. In a table cell or a noun-ending fragment (없음, 포함, 추천) add no period: use parentheses, a colon or a comma (없음(완전 냉방); 최고: 낮은 습도). For an aside or gloss on a word use half-width parentheses attached to that word with no space before the opening parenthesis, and put the word's particle after the closing parenthesis (초과 수하물 요금(kg 단위)이 적용됩니다; never 요금이(kg 단위) or 요금(kg 단위) 이). Two parentheses keep the space before them that shipped copy gives them: a currency conversion (400~500바트 (약 11~14달러)) and the as-of marker (무료로 포함돼요 (2026년 7월 기준).). Before an explanation or a list of examples use a colon attached to the word before it and followed by one space. A bold label or lead-in takes the colon inside the bold rather than a dash after it (**그린피:** 평일 요금), and so do a list item's lead word (2. 버스: 방콕의 …) and a dash inside a bold heading (**2. 중급 코스: 2,500~3,500바트(평일)**); but when the lead is itself a complete sentence ending in -요 or -세요, close it with a period, inside the bold when bold (**클럽에 직접 연락하세요.** 여행 한참 전에…). Between short parallel nouns use an unspaced · (U+00B7, not ㆍ or the Japanese ・; 숏게임·특수 클럽), never · as a clause separator in place of a dash. Tilde ~ (ASCII U+007E, not ∼, ～ or 〜) for ranges only, which in Korean includes a span between two places (550~950바트; 방콕~후아힌), never as a separator; three or more places in a row take · (랏차쁘라송·프런칫·랑수언).
